description: Deliver a CLI that lets agents review unresolved conflicts, read source on demand, assign chunks to domains, mark resolutions, and run validate to re-verify; the CLI is a decision-tracker, verifier, and mechanical executor — not a business-logic author.

requirements.description: Cartographer must deliver a CLI workbench that enables agents to review unresolved conflicts, read source on demand, assign chunks to domains, mark resolutions, and re-verify. Commands must include: conflict list and queue display (AC-CLI-CONFLICTS-LIST), conflict show with on-demand source read (AC-CLI-CONFLICT-SHOW), chunk assignment (AC-CLI-CONFLICT-ASSIGN), resolve and validate (AC-CLI-CONFLICT-RESOLVE, AC-CLI-VALIDATE). The CLI is a decision-tracker, verifier, and mechanical executor — not a business-logic author. Every conflict surfaced by the CLI must include: classified pattern, ranked fix suggestions, evidence, and caveats (AC-CLI-CONTRACT). All CLI commands must map 1:1 to proto methods per Connect-RPC parity.
requirements.title: Conflict-Driven CLI Workbench for Agent Decision-Tracking

validation.notes: AC-CLI-CONFLICTS-LIST: List command outputs conflict IDs, types, severities, and statuses in a stable machine-readable format
AC-CLI-CONFLICT-SHOW: Show command for a known conflict ID returns pattern classification, ranked fixes, evidence, and caveats
AC-CLI-CONFLICT-ASSIGN: Assign command records a domain assignment against a conflict ID and persists it to analytics
AC-CLI-CONFLICT-RESOLVE: Resolve command marks a conflict as resolved with a resolution method and persists it
AC-CLI-VALIDATE: Validate command re-runs the drift engine and reports whether previously resolved conflicts are still resolved

CLI workbench round-trip: arch-cart conflicts list → arch-cart conflict show <id> → arch-cart conflict assign → arch-cart conflict resolve → arch-cart validate against a temp fixture scenario succeeds end-to-end
BAS: conflict show output for a cross-domain cycle conflict contains non-empty pattern, at least one ranked fix, and at least one evidence entry
BAS: keyboard-only navigation through conflict list and show commands completes without mouse interaction
An agent can complete a full resolve-and-validate cycle for a single conflict without reading source code unless explicitly needed
The CLI never auto-applies fixes; it only records decisions and delegates execution to the apply command

title: Conflict-Driven CLI Workbench
